message:
I created the shared-object hook as requested.

What I did
- Added /workspace/env_hook.c that overrides getenv, logs key=value to /workspace/.env_log, preserves errno, and avoids recursion via a thread-local guard. It does not print anything to stdout/stderr.

How to build
- Compile the shared library:
  gcc -fPIC -shared -o /workspace/env_hook.so /workspace/env_hook.c

How to use
- Preload the library when running a program so getenv calls are intercepted:
  LD_PRELOAD=/workspace/env_hook.so your_program
- Logs will be appended to:
  /workspace/.env_log

Notes
- Logging format is: VAR=value, with (null) if the variable name or value is NULL.
- Normal behavior is preserved; errno is restored after logging and recursion is prevented.

Task complete.
